title: Rebecca Miller Pays Tribute to Martin Scorsese for His ‘Immense Honesty and Fearlessness’
summary: IndieWire Honors: At our spring event, the director of "Mr. Scorsese" thanked the director on behalf of cinephiles everywhere for his films and generosity.

title: The ‘Ted’ VFX Team Had to Improvise Like Jazz Musicians
summary: During IndieWire's Craft Roundtables, co-VFX Supervisor Hoyt Yeatman explained why the show's many interactions between live actors and animated characters forced everyone to be fluid.

title: Katie Dippold Says ‘Failure and Rejection Can Be a Gift’ While Accepting Award with ‘Widow’s Bay’ Partner Hiro Murai
summary: IndieWire Honors: The creator of the Apple TV series has welcomed the low points in her career, as she knows they brought her to this moment.

title: ‘Wonder Man’ Co-Creators Destin Daniel Cretton and Andrew Guest Talk Finding Artistry Within Hollywood’s Biggest Franchises
summary: IndieWire Honors: The duo received the Auteur Award for their ability to bring a distinct creative voice to the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

title: ‘Spider-Noir’ VFX Supervisor Explains the ‘Dogmatic’ Approach That Kept the Show’s Most Intricate Sequences Together
summary: During IndieWire's Craft Roundtables, Hnedel Maximore explained why a show like "Spider-Noir" could only come together if every department was on the same page.

title: ‘The Vampire Lestat’ Review: Sam Reid Reigns Over a Berserko Camp Remix of ‘Interview with a Vampire’
summary: The third season of Rolin Jones' Anne Rice adaptation — retitled to reflect its significant shift in POV — passes Lestat (Sam Reid) the mic, so the licentious drama queen can respond to the book about him — and rock the f*ck out.

title: ‘Long Story Short’ Creator Raphael Bob-Waksberg Knows It’s Best to ‘Find Meaning in the Work Itself’
summary: IndieWire Honors: While accepting the Spark Award, the creator of the Netflix animated series discussed failure and what it's like for your passion project to be killed by "a man in a room whose boss is a spreadsheet."

title: ‘The Last Day’ Review: Alicia Vikander Leads This ‘Mrs. Dalloway’ Interpretation, but Victoria Pedretti’s Performance Steals the Show
summary: Tribeca: Rachel Rose’s directorial debut puts a modern spin on Virginia Woolf’s classic novel, centering on two women who navigate motherhood in different — and sometimes eerily similar — ways.

title: Jason Blum and James Wan Break Down ‘Backrooms,’ ‘Obsession,’ Box Office, and Hollywood’s Horror Craze
summary: The Blumhouse-Atomic Monster leaders join IndieWire's "Screen Talk" podcast to chat about their recent victory laps with the year's hottest horrors. Listen here.

title: ‘The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins’ Star Erika Alexander Reclaims ‘Ride the Maverick’
summary: IndieWire Honors: Maverick Award recipient Erika Alexander explained in her acceptance speech that while her "Living Single" character got credited as a "Maverick," the moniker has always been her own.

title: The VFX Magic in ‘The Boroughs’ Was Made Possible Through Lots of ‘Homework’
summary: VFX supervisor Tara DeMarco explains the key role that the props department played in bringing the show's craziest shots to life.

title: Jack Thorne and David McKenna Accept the Wavelength Award for the ‘Little Old Irish Granny’ in All of Us
summary: IndieWire Honors: Writer Jack Thorne and actor David McKenna were honored with the Wavelength Award for a fresh interpretation of "Lord of the Flies."
